caveat: Every number behind this recommendation comes from classical models on foreground-masked MEAN SPECTRA. That representation discards all spatial structure, and the project's own bracket puts ~25 macro-F1 points of the deployed model in exactly what it discards. A proxy plateau is therefore a LOWER bound on the budget a spatial-spectral network needs (CHANGES F-3). Run the `neural` stage before treating the budget as settled.
